twap_equals_spot.meaning: computed TWAP value equals the current spot price (tradePrice)

deviation_check_enforced.meaning: validatePrice rejects transactions whose current price deviates too much from the time-weighted average

assumptions: validatePrice() is invoked on a transaction whose current price deviates too much from the time-weighted average.
The deviation threshold and comparison logic are not specified in the report fragments.

unresolved.description: Exact deviation threshold and comparison logic for rejecting a transaction are not given; the check-enforcement observable is a qualitative Boolean.

limitations: The report states a design/capability flaw rather than an observed exploit transaction.
The claim formalizes only the oracle_check_useless impact; the TWAP-equals-spot mechanism is bound as the observable relation, not as a separate impact.
